title: Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.01601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. translated_abstract: 决策模型通常需要对编码在单个序列中的、数量可变的候选动作集合进行评分。这一设置在生成式系统中的“系统1”（System 1）组件中越来越常见，因为在不同的运行过程中，候选动作可能以不同的方式被提出或排序。标准的因果交叉编码具有很强的表达能力，但它可能导致候选动作的评分依赖于序列化的顺序，而非底层决策问题本身。我们提出了候选独立块因果注意力，它在共享上下文和每个候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断跨候选的信息流动并重置候选位置。我们在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B 和 Qwen3 4B 三种骨干模型上，将该架构与标准因果注意力以及互补的不变性基线方法进行了比较。候选独立注意力在保持有竞争力的决策质量的同时，始终降低了置换敏感性；消融实验表明，候选
tldr: 提出候选独立块因果注意力机制，通过阻断候选动作之间的信息流动，使决策模型的评分对候选排列顺序具有鲁棒性，同时保持有竞争力的决策质量。
